headline: Can Corning’s (GLW) Cell Culture Momentum Quietly Reshape Its Core Investment Narrative?
summary: Recent reports highlighted that Wall Street analysts raised their quarterly earnings estimate for Corning, expecting US$0.76 per share, with projected strength in Life Sciences and Optical Communications while Automotive faces softer demand. Corning also featured among leading suppliers in the expanding global cell culture market, particularly in Asia-Pacific, underlining the growing importance of its Life Sciences segment.
